B0DN1H69ZP.title: Aqara Smart Light Switch H2 (2-in-1 Neutral, 2 Buttons, 1 Channel)
bullets: Versatile Wiring Compatibility: The switch supports both single-pole and 3-way configurations, making it an ideal choice for various home setups. It functions seamlessly with or without a neutral wire, ensuring compatibility with older and modern electrical systems. Simply replace one traditional 3-way switch with the H2 US to enable smart control of lights from two locations, enhancing convenience and automation.

Decoupled Switch Mode: The switch includes 1 electrical switch (also functions as a wireless switch), and 1 pure wireless switch, hence 2 wireless switches in total, enabling sophisticated and technically impressive automations when paired with other Aqara products. For the top button, you can disable its physical control of the relay, allowing it to function like the decoupled buttons below for triggering scenes or automations

Thread/Zigbee Protocol: The smart light switch supports Matter-over-Thread and Zigbee, ensuring compatibility with major third-party platforms such as Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings, and Home Assistant. In Zigbee mode, users can access the full range of Aqara Home features, including MARS Tech and LED indicator customization.(Note:Zigbee2MQTT and comparable third-party USB dongles are not Aqara-supported. Full product functionality may be limited or unavailable)

2-in-1 Neutral Compatibility: There are no compatibility issues with the Smart Wall Light Switch, which supports both neutral and no-neutral wiring to simplify installation. However, features such as power monitoring and overload protection only work with neutral.（Note: These features may be unavailable in some third-party Matter ecosystems.)

Power-Off Memory Mode: This feature ensures your appliance retains its last settings after a power outage, automatically resuming operation as it was—either on or off. For added flexibility, you can customize its behavior in Aqara Home, choosing to restore previous settings, always power on, always power off, or even reverse the previous state. Note: This feature of customizing its behavior may not be available in some third-party Matter ecosystems. For full functionality, we recommend using Zigbee mode with an Aqara hub.
Home Automation: This smart switch supports remote control, scheduling, voice commands, and integration with other smart devices for seamless Smart Home automation.

B0F2N68K3C.title: Aqara Smart Dimmer Switch H2, 2-in-1 Neutral, Thread/Zigbee Protocol
bullets: Thread/Zigbee Protocol: Aqara smart dimmer switch H2 supports matter-over-thread and zigbee, ensuring compatibility with major third-party platforms such as Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings, and Home Assistant. In Zigbee mode, users can access the full range of Aqara Home features, including dimming range,indicator light setting,On/Off transition settings,brightness adjustment increment(Zigbee2MQTT and comparable third-party USB dongles are not officially supported by Aqara. Full product functionality may be limited or unavailable）

2-in-1 Neutral for Hassle-Free Installation: The led dimmer switch supports both no-neutral and with-neutral wiring setups, eliminating any concerns about your home's wiring configuration. For homes without a neutral wire, installation is straight forward, while for homes with neutral wiring, overload protection is enabled, while additional advanced features such as power monitoring

Silent On/Off and Dimming: All three buttons operate silently for a quieter environment. The top button turns the light on/off, while the other two adjust brightness. Enjoy smooth dimming from soft ambient light to full brightness. By default, lights toggle in 0.5 seconds, and each dimmer press changes brightness by 10%, and users can also customize this percentage in the Aqara Home app

Extensive Light Compatibility: The dimmer switch offers wide light compatibility, supporting incandescent, halogen, dimmable CFL/LED, and ELV types of non-smart lamps. Compatible with both forward and reverse phase dimming can easily match existing lamps, bring a stable dimming experience, ready for future lighting upgrades

Custom Brightness Limits: Set your preferred maximum and minimum brightness levels to prevent flickering or power loss. Maximum Brightness ensures smooth performance for low-power lights, while Minimum Brightness prevents flickering or failure at low levels. Once configured, the lights cannot be brightened above or dimmed below that setting
